name: Temporary staffing
summary: Named clinicians for a defined stretch of weeks, with an end date on the request.
body:
Temporary staffing covers a leave, a census spike, or a project with a known end. Tell us the specialty, the shift, and the week you need someone on the unit.

The request form can open with this service already selected.

seo.title: Temporary staffing
seo.description: Named clinicians for a defined stretch of weeks, with an end date on the request.

name: Shift coverage
summary: Per-diem and short blocks when a posted shift would otherwise go uncovered.
body:
Shift coverage is for the board you already have: a night, a weekend, or a short run of days. Include the start window in the staffing needs field.

Use the location page when the coverage is tied to one service area.

seo.title: Shift coverage
seo.description: Per-diem and short blocks when a posted shift would otherwise go uncovered.

name: Permanent placement
summary: A retained search for a role you intend to keep on the unit.
body:
Permanent placement is a different conversation from a 13-week assignment. Share the employment type, the reporting line, and whether the role is on-site or hybrid.

Clinicians still apply through the opening. Hiring teams start here.

seo.title: Permanent placement
seo.description: A retained search for a role you intend to keep on the unit.
